transcript:
MARTIN: DAVID! Talk to me! What is it?

[SFX: As David opens a door and runs through the doorway, it closes behind him. He hear as he runs off the door opening again. The moan following him.]

[SFX: David runs for a while. Finally slowing, and out of breath speaks into the phone. ]

DAVID (Panicked and whispered):  I... I saw them... They came after me, man... They came after me...

MARTIN: Tell me you're out of there.

DAVID (Panicked and whispered): I couldn’t.. They were in front of the exit... I think one followed me.

[SFX: A door opens in the distance.]

DAVID (CONT’D) (Panicked and whispered): Damnit...
